name: Local Structure Example
description:
Adds a compact weathered stone shrine to newly generated Overworld terrain. Copy the complete 03_adv_18_local_structure folder into lua_scripts so its manifest, entrypoint, and JSON template stay together.

Explore new chunks and look for a broken cobblestone foundation surrounding a tall central pillar with a glowstone beacon. Roughly one in six chunks is eligible, and each eligible chunk tries up to four safe surface positions before giving up. Each shrine selects a horizontal rotation and mirror deterministically, palette variants mix cobblestone with mossy cobblestone, and the decay processor removes a few blocks. The template path is derived from the typed structure key.
